agri-calculator.name: Agriculture Calculator
agri-calculator.intro: A multi-purpose agriculture calculator covering fertilizer ratio, planting density, pesticide dilution, irrigation water, incubation countdown and machinery fuel use.

assessor-1.name: Harvest Loss Rate (Machine/Manual) Assessor
assessor-1.intro: Evaluate harvest loss for machine or manual harvesting from before-and-after crop weights, and check it against loss-rate standards to support harvester scheduling and loss reduction.

calc-12.name: Irrigation Water Requirement Estimator
calc-12.intro: Estimate gross irrigation water use from irrigated area, planned irrigation depth and the irrigation efficiency coefficient, for drip, sprinkler and flood systems.

calc-13.name: Farm Machinery Fuel Consumption Estimator
calc-13.intro: Estimate hourly and total diesel use from engine power, load factor and specific fuel consumption, with optional fuel price, for farm machinery cost accounting.

calc-15.name: Sowing Date Calculator
calc-15.intro: Work back from a target harvest date and crop growth period to the recommended sowing date, helping growers hit the best sowing window.

calc-2.name: Planting Density Calculator (Spacing × Row)
calc-2.intro: Given plant spacing, row spacing and area, calculate theoretical planting density and total plant count to plan sowing rates and rational close planting.

calc-36.name: Crop Water Requirement (ET) Calculator
calc-36.intro: Compute crop water requirement from reference evapotranspiration ET₀, crop coefficient and growth stage to guide irrigation quotas and water-saving design.

calc-37.name: Daily Light Integral (DLI) Calculator
calc-37.intro: Integrate light intensity and duration into daily light integral (DLI) to assess whether greenhouse crops receive enough light, for supplementary lighting and photoperiod control.

calc-38.name: Irrigation Uniformity (Christiansen's Coefficient)
calc-38.intro: From catch-can water depths at each measuring point, compute Christiansen's uniformity coefficient to assess sprinkler and drip system evenness for acceptance testing.

calc-6.name: Livestock Stocking Capacity Estimator
calc-6.intro: From house area, stocking density and rearing cycle, estimate carrying capacity and annual batches to support capacity planning, feed purchasing and manure handling.

calc-7.name: Fertigation (Drip) Ratio Adjuster
calc-7.intro: Calculate the stock-solution ratio and injection volume for fertigation drip systems from growth stage, target nutrient concentration and fertiliser content.

calc-8.name: Soil pH Adjustment Calculator
calc-8.intro: From current and target soil pH, compute the lime or sulfur needed to amend acidic or alkaline soil and improve planting suitability.

calc-ventilation-2.name: Greenhouse Ventilation Volume (Air Changes) Calculator
calc-ventilation-2.intro: From greenhouse dimensions and target air changes per hour, estimate the required ventilation rate and fan configuration to keep temperature and humidity in range.

calculator-calc-1.name: Sowing Date Calculator (Frost-Free Period)
calculator-calc-1.intro: Work back from the local frost-free period and crop growth period to safe sowing and harvest dates, reducing frost risk.

calculator-calc-concentration.name: Pesticide Dilution Concentration Calculator
calculator-calc-concentration.intro: From active-ingredient concentration and target dilution ratio, calculate the pesticide and water mix for precise spraying and safe intervals.

calculator-calc-density.name: Planting Density Calculator (By Spacing)
calculator-calc-density.intro: Enter plant and row spacing (or band width) to get theoretical planting density and total plants per unit area for close-planting schemes and yield potential.

calculator-calc-ratio.name: N-P-K Fertilizer Ratio Calculator
calculator-calc-ratio.intro: Enter target N-P-K nutrient requirements and application area, choose common straight fertilisers, and get each fertiliser amount plus a cost estimate.

calculator-calc-ratio-1.name: Feed Mix Ratio Calculator (by Nutrient Content)
calculator-calc-ratio-1.intro: Blend two feed ingredients to a target nutrient level using the cross (Pearson square) method, supporting livestock ration design.

calculator-calc-soil.name: Soil pH Adjustment Calculator (Sulfur or Lime)
calculator-calc-soil.intro: Enter current and target soil pH, soil texture and area to estimate the lime (to raise pH) or sulfur (to lower pH) needed.

canopy-coverage.name: Canopy Coverage Estimator
canopy-coverage.intro: Estimate canopy coverage from row spacing, plant spacing, canopy diameter and overlap, or by grid-counting green pixels in a photo, and read intercepted light to judge canopy closure.

continuous-cropping-index.name: Continuous Cropping Obstacle Index Calculator
continuous-cropping-index.intro: Score the risk of continuous-cropping obstacles from cropping years, crop sensitivity, soil pathogen load, organic matter and pH, and get a graded risk level to guide rotation and soil improvement.

convert-content-1.name: Agricultural Dry Matter & Moisture Conversion
convert-content-1.intro: Convert between moisture content and dry-matter content, or derive dry-matter weight from initial weight and moisture, for grain storage, purchase pricing and raw-material accounting.

countdown-4.name: Egg Incubation Countdown (21 Days)
countdown-4.intro: Set the incubation date to follow the 21-day chick embryo development day by day, with current stage, temperature and humidity and candling reminders.

countdown-cycle.name: Harvest Countdown (by Crop Growth Cycle)
countdown-cycle.intro: Choose a crop and planting date to predict the harvest date and show the current growth stage, with support for multiple batches.

crop-rotation.name: Crop Rotation Planner
crop-rotation.intro: Based on the legume → cereal → leafy → root rotation principle, pick area and starting season to generate a four-year rotation plan with the crop and reason for each season.

crop-water-requirement.name: Crop Water Requirement Calculator
crop-water-requirement.intro: Enter crop coefficient Kc and reference evapotranspiration ET₀ to compute crop evapotranspiration ETc = Kc × ET₀ and convert it into daily irrigation water use by area.

crop-yield.name: Crop Yield Estimator
crop-yield.intro: Estimate yield from ears per unit area, grains per ear and thousand-grain weight, with multiple crops and historical yield references.

cycle-honey.name: Honey Harvest Cycle Planner
cycle-honey.intro: Plan the honey-extraction cycle for each hive from its flow period and start date, and generate a harvest schedule to keep apiary work organised.

detector-13.name: Varroa Mite Infestation Detector
detector-13.intro: Detect varroa mite infestation rate from the sample worker-bee count and mites found, and assess the colony parasite load for treatment decisions.

detector-nutrition.name: Bee Pollen (Fermented) Nutrient Analysis
detector-nutrition.intro: Assess the nutritional quality and fermentation degree of (fermented) bee pollen from protein, fat, reducing sugar, moisture, ash and lactic acid content.

dli-calculator.name: DLI Calculator
dli-calculator.intro: Enter PPFD and daily lighting hours to compute daily light integral (DLI, mol/m²/d) and compare it with crop requirements to decide supplementary lighting strategy.

dry-matter-conversion.name: Dry Matter Conversion Calculator
dry-matter-conversion.intro: Convert between fresh weight, dry weight and moisture content, with standard-moisture normalisation for grain purchase and forage measurement.

estimate-3.name: Irrigation Water Requirement Estimator (ET-based)
estimate-3.intro: Estimate crop water requirement and irrigation amount over a period from crop coefficient (Kc) and reference evapotranspiration (ET₀).

estimate-analysis.name: Canopy Coverage Estimator (Photo Analysis)
estimate-analysis.intro: Estimate canopy coverage from the green-pixel share of a canopy photo to assess crop vigour and canopy closure, for population monitoring and remote-sensing validation.

estimate-area-density.name: Livestock Stocking Capacity Estimator (Area × Density)
estimate-area-density.intro: Enter stocking area, density and average body weight to quickly estimate total stock, total biomass and yield per unit area.

estimate-area-yield.name: Forage Yield Estimator (Yield × Area)
estimate-area-yield.intro: Enter fresh forage yield per unit area, area and dry-matter rate to estimate total fresh and dry forage and the number of hay bales.

estimate-content-soil.name: Soil Organic Matter Estimator (Loss-on-Ignition)
estimate-content-soil.intro: Enter crucible empty weight and pre- and post-ignition dry soil weight to estimate soil organic matter and organic carbon by loss-on-ignition, for rapid lab fertility assessment.

estimate-fuel-engine-oil.name: Farm Machinery Fuel Consumption Estimator (per Unit Area)
estimate-fuel-engine-oil.intro: Enter operation area and total fuel use to compute fuel consumption per unit area and fuel cost, with optional hours and fuel price.

estimate-soil.name: Continuous Cropping Obstacle Index Estimator (Pathogen Build-up)
estimate-soil.intro: From continuous-cropping years and the annual pathogen growth rate, estimate soil pathogen accumulation and the continuous-cropping obstacle risk level.

estimate-yield-rate.name: Fertilizer Use Efficiency Estimator (N-P-K Uptake)
estimate-yield-rate.intro: From fertiliser applied and nutrients removed by the harvest, compute apparent N, P and K use efficiency by the difference method to quantify uptake efficiency and losses.

fertigation-ratio.name: Fertigation Ratio Calculator
fertigation-ratio.intro: From a target EC value, calculate the fertiliser stock-solution ratio, injection rate and nutrient concentration for precise drip fertigation control.

fertilizer-calculator.name: Fertilizer Ratio Calculator
fertilizer-calculator.intro: Support N-P-K compound blending, soil-test-based recommendations and base/top-dressing schemes for scientific and reduced fertiliser use.

fertilizer-efficiency.name: Fertilizer Efficiency Estimator
fertilizer-efficiency.intro: Estimate current-season N, P and K use efficiency by the difference method to assess fertiliser plans and guide reduction for higher efficiency.

gdd-calculator.name: GDD Calculator
gdd-calculator.intro: Accumulate growing degree days (GDD) to predict crop development stages and phenology, supporting field-timing management and maturity-group selection.

greenhouse-rolling-time.name: Greenhouse Film-Rolling Time Advisor
greenhouse-rolling-time.intro: Recommend when to roll or unroll greenhouse film based on temperature, wind speed and humidity, supporting greenhouse climate control and crop protection.

greenhouse-ventilation.name: Greenhouse Ventilation Calculator
greenhouse-ventilation.intro: Calculate the required ventilation rate, air changes per hour and vent area to keep crop conditions suitable and support ventilation system sizing.

harvest-date-predictor.name: Harvest Date Predictor
harvest-date-predictor.intro: Predict the best harvest window from grain moisture and maturity to cut shattering and mould losses.

harvest-loss-rate.name: Harvest Loss Rate Calculator
harvest-loss-rate.intro: Assess harvest loss rate for machine or manual harvesting, break down loss sources and give optimisation advice to improve grain recovery.

harvest-planner.name: Harvest Planner
harvest-planner.intro: Plan harvest windows, labour needs, machine efficiency and progress for large-scale harvesting with people-and-machine scheduling.

irrigation-calculator.name: Irrigation Water Calculator
irrigation-calculator.intro: Support different irrigation methods, crop water coefficients and soil types, and estimate water charges to help with water-saving irrigation plans.

irrigation-uniformity.name: Irrigation Uniformity Calculator
irrigation-uniformity.intro: From flow or water-depth readings at each point, compute Christiansen's uniformity coefficient (CU) and distribution uniformity (DU) to spot clogging or pressure imbalance.

machinery-efficiency.name: Machinery Efficiency Comparison
machinery-efficiency.intro: Calculate and compare area-per-hour efficiency, fuel use and economics across several machines to support machinery selection and job scheduling.

mulch-coverage.name: Mulch Coverage Calculator
mulch-coverage.intro: Work out plastic-film quantity, covered area and coverage rate to plan purchase and laying and reduce waste.

nongjijuzuoyexiaolv-mu-xiaoshi-duibi.name: Farm Machinery Efficiency (Mu/Hour) Comparison
nongjijuzuoyexiaolv-mu-xiaoshi-duibi.intro: Enter working width, speed, hours and actual area to compare theoretical and actual machinery efficiency and assess machine utilisation.

pesticide-dose.name: Pesticide Dilution Calculator
pesticide-dose.intro: Professional pesticide dilution and ratio calculation with spraying methods, a common-pesticide reference table and pre-harvest-interval lookup.

pesticide-interval.name: Pesticide Pre-Harvest Interval Countdown
pesticide-interval.intro: Choose a pesticide and enter the application date to count down to the safe harvest date (PHI values for reference only).

ratio-10.name: Fertigation Drip Ratio (EC/pH) Adjuster
ratio-10.intro: From target EC, source-water EC and stock-solution EC, calculate the dilution ratio and injection-pump ratio for a drip fertigation system.

seed-germination-rate.name: Seed Germination Rate & Vigour Index Calculator
seed-germination-rate.intro: Enter the number of seeds tested and daily germination counts to compute germination percentage, germination energy, germination index (GI) and vigour index (VI).

soil-organic-matter.name: Soil Organic Matter Estimator
soil-organic-matter.intro: Estimate organic matter and organic carbon by the loss-on-ignition method to support soil-fertility assessment and fertilisation decisions.

storage-pest-alert.name: Stored-Grain Pest Temperature Alert
storage-pest-alert.intro: Predict pest outbreak risk from bin temperature, humidity and grain type and give control advice to protect stored grain.

straw-return.name: Straw Return Rate Optimizer
straw-return.intro: Optimise the amount of straw returned to the field and the supplementary nitrogen needed, based on carbon-to-nitrogen balance, to avoid nitrogen deficiency after return.

temp-2.name: Stored-Grain Pest Outbreak Temperature Alert
temp-2.intro: Enter grain temperature, bin humidity and grain type to judge the risk level of a stored-grain pest outbreak and give handling advice.

temp-time-2.name: Greenhouse Film-Rolling Time Advisor (Temp/Wind)
temp-time-2.intro: Enter inside and outside temperatures, wind speed and film ventilation area to estimate natural-ventilation cooling capacity and advise on vent opening height and timing.
